name: Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode.casesOn
typeText:
{motive : Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode → Sort u} →
  (t : Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode) →
    motive Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode.all →
      motive Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode.default →
        motive Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode.reducible → motive Lean.Meta.TransparencyMode.instances → motive t

source.code:
/--
Which constants should be unfolded?
-/
inductive TransparencyMode where
  /-- Unfolds all constants, even those tagged as `@[irreducible]`. -/
  | all
  /-- Unfolds all constants except those tagged as `@[irreducible]`. -/
  | default
  /-- Unfolds only constants tagged with the `@[reducible]` attribute. -/
  | reducible
  /-- Unfolds reducible constants and constants tagged with the `@[instance]` attribute. -/
  | instances
  deriving Inhabited, BEq
